dimensions.eventTimeSemantics: The event time at which the defect was created; never a resolution or snapshot timestamp.
The event time at which an approved resolution outcome became effective.
The completion event time of a manual test run.

descriptions.en-US: An actor-authorized artifact that can support an Agent claim.
descriptions.zh-CN: 由 Agent 授权读取并可用于支持 Claim 的附件。

descriptions.en-US: A delivery or testing team in the organization.
descriptions.zh-CN: 组织中的交付或测试团队。

descriptions.en-US: A person who executes a test run.
An ECU or module assigned to a defect or feature.
descriptions.zh-CN: 分配缺陷或功能的 ECU/模块。
车辆软件 OS 代际。

descriptions.en-US: A uniquely identified quality defect in Octane.
descriptions.zh-CN: Octane 中唯一标识的质量缺陷。

descriptions.en-US: A gate that evaluates product quality under approved rules.
descriptions.zh-CN: 按照已批准规则评估产品质量的门禁。

descriptions.en-US: A node in the AIDA requirement hierarchy.
descriptions.zh-CN: AIDA 需求层级中的节点。

descriptions.en-US: A reusable definition of a test intent.
descriptions.zh-CN: 定义可重复执行的测试意图。

descriptions.en-US: One traceable execution of a test case.
descriptions.zh-CN: 测试用例的一次可追溯执行。

metrics.description: Elapsed calendar days under an approved clock-stop rule.
metrics.grain: one age value per defect at snapshot

metrics.description: Distinct defect primary keys in the authorized snapshot and selected scope.
Distinct defects grouped or filtered by their creation event time.
metrics.grain: one row per distinct defect_id creation event

metrics.description: Distinct eligible defects whose approved age exceeds an approved threshold.
metrics.grain: one current snapshot state per eligible defect

metrics.description: Distinct defects not in the approved terminal status set at the snapshot time.
metrics.grain: one current snapshot state per defect

metrics.description: Distinct defects classified by an approved rejection outcome rule.
metrics.grain: one approved rejection outcome per defect

metrics.description: Approved rejected defects divided by the approved defect cohort denominator.
Defects with an approved duplicate linkage divided by an approved defect cohort.
Approved resolved defects divided by the approved defect cohort denominator.
Distinct defects entering an approved resolved outcome during the resolution-time window.
metrics.grain: one approved resolution event per defect

metrics.description: Defect count divided by an explicitly approved size or exposure denominator.
Distinct defects attributed to the canonical problem-finder team field.
metrics.grain: one row per distinct defect_id and problem-finder team

metrics.description: An approved discovery outcome divided by an approved execution or effort denominator.
Distinct manual runs attributed to a tester or team.
metrics.grain: one row per distinct mr_id and authorized team attribution

metrics.description: Failed runs divided by the approved eligible-run denominator.
Distinct manual runs with the canonical Failed status.
metrics.grain: one row per distinct failed mr_id

metrics.description: Passed runs divided by the approved eligible-run denominator.
Distinct manual runs with the canonical Passed status.
metrics.grain: one row per distinct passed mr_id

metrics.description: Requirements with approved validating test cases divided by the approved requirement population.
Distinct manual run IDs completed in the selected scope.
Distinct test case IDs in the selected scope.
Eligible test runs with approved requirement links divided by eligible runs.
